scope: Root mesh_rgb.rgb_infer adapter and mocked tests only; no native scientific source changes, actual NN/API/model jobs, original/result/process edits by this agent.
cause: Prior worker imported run and appearance.extract in one process. SimSaC/ERP inference caches/model memory could remain resident while appearance initialized another backbone. Actual05 completed NN output was preserved before interruption during appearance initialization.
fix: Call unchanged native run CLI then unchanged native appearance CLI in serial finite subprocesses. Each process exits before the next starts; no NN modules imported in worker. Use runtime.change_python, inherited os.environ including existing leased GPU/CUDA/TORCH_HOME, and one shared monotonic stage deadline. start_new_session=false preserves worker process group. Existing engine.run_worker starts the worker group and kills it with SIGTERM/SIGKILL on cancellation; no nested GPU lease/session/group introduced.

scope: Appearance failure preserves completed NN without a success result

recovery_required_checks: changes Gaussian/existing-result flags false; keypoint_plan_used true
pair-audit length1282; each declared pair checksum and query/reference RGB metadata/opposite epoch consistent
Preserve completed NN artifacts in new recovery output with original checksums
Run ONLY native appearance under main's new GPU lease
Appearance checkpoint SHA matches NN model, source_manifest_sha256 matches unchanged NN manifest, descriptors_sha256 matches object-appearance.npz
Clearly mark NN reused from interrupted05 and appearance newly executed; not an all-new NN rerun

result_contract.note: Recovery must add explicit reused-NN/new-appearance provenance; fresh_predictions describes actual saved05 NN, not a claim it reran in recovery. Main owns verification/recovery and result commitment.
